body.x: iLuv(www.iluv.com), a provider of innovative mobile accessories, unveiled "Aud Mini 6" at CES 2015, which runs Jan. 6-9 in Las Vegas.Aud Mini 6 is a speaker that is the same size of iPhone 6. The speaker is splash‐proof and includes a carabiner allowing users to clip the device to their backpack or purse for the ultimate listening experience practically anywhere. Music streamed wirelessly via Bluetooth is delivered with big, full range sound thanks to the powerful speaker and passive radiator. Additionally, Aud Mini 6 offers a built‐in microphone for convenient hands‐free phone calls. The speaker features a rechargeable battery and dual color LED to indicate power and charge status. Aud Mini 6 is available in black, green, and pink and gray.
